title: A cross-species AAV platform for precise microglial interrogation
title_zh: 跨物种AAV平台实现精准小胶质细胞探测
abstract: Targeting microglia with adeno-associated viruses (AAVs) remains challenging because of inefficient transduction, off-target expression, and inconsistent payload performance. Here, we develop an integrated, Cre-independent AAV platform that combines a compact 446-bp microglia-specific regulatory element (MSRE), a high-yield AAV2/9.m capsid, microRNA-mediated neuronal de-targeting, and a microglia-tailored codon-optimization strategy. Following direct intracranial delivery, the optimized vector achieves robust, long-lasting transgene expression with greater than 90% microglial specificity across multiple mouse brain regions, including in an Alzheimer's disease model. With doxorubicin-assisted delivery, the platform also enables efficient and selective microglial targeting in rats, rhesus macaques, and human ex vivo brain slices. Codon optimization supports the expression of otherwise challenging functional payloads, enabling calcium imaging, chemogenetic manipulation, and CRISPR-Cas9-mediated genome editing. This cross-species toolkit provides a versatile resource for investigating microglial biology and developing microglia-directed therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 利用腺相关病毒（AAV）靶向小胶质细胞仍面临转导效率低、脱靶表达和载荷表现不一致等挑战。我们开发了一种集成的、Cre无关的AAV平台，结合了一个紧凑的446 bp小胶质细胞特异性调控元件（MSRE）、高产率的AAV2/9.m包膜、微RNA介导的神经元去靶化以及针对小胶质细胞的密码子优化策略。经直接颅内递送后，优化后的载体在多种小鼠脑区（包括阿尔茨海默病模型）中实现了强劲、持久的转基因表达，且小胶质细胞特异性超过90%。在多柔比星辅助递送的帮助下，该平台还可在大鼠、猕猴和人类离体脑片中高效且选择性地靶向小胶质细胞。密码子优化支持原本难以表达的功能载荷的表达，使得钙成像、化学遗传操控和CRISPR‑Cas9介导的基因组编辑成为可能。该跨物种工具包为研究小胶质细胞生物学和开发针对小胶质细胞的治疗策略提供了多功能资源。
